title: The Return (hero introduction)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_global_styles: epic South Indian cinematic hero-entry score played only on Indian classical and folk instruments
Raga Shanmukhapriya mood: fierce heroic minor with a raised fourth
one 4-note heroic motif passed between many instruments
a different set of Indian instruments in every section
wide cinematic stereo, powerful modern mix

positive_local_styles: instant wall of chenda melam drums and thavil hits on beat one
full energy from the first second
saraswati veena plucks the motif low and tense
70 BPM half-time, steady pulse, no silence
mridangam and tabla rolls speeding up in layers
sitar and sarod jhala strumming faster
the motif climbs higher each bar
full chenda melam with thavil, dhol and pakhawaj thundering
nadaswaram and shehnai trade the full heroic theme
Tamil folk dance groove at 140 BPM, maximum energy
a tihai on all the drums landing hard on the final beat

brief.raga: Shanmukhapriya (Carnatic melakarta 56): fierce and heroic, minor colour with a raised 4th (prati madhyamam). The hero motif is 4 notes: Sa, Ri, Ga (minor), then a leap to the raised Ma, held.
brief.tempo: 70 BPM in half-time for the walk, felt as 140 BPM after the drop
brief.lead: nadaswaram and shehnai, with veena, sitar, sarod, sarangi, santoor; drums: chenda, thavil, mridangam, tabla, pakhawaj, dhol, parai, urumi, ghatam, kanjira; plus kombu, morsing, khartal, manjira, tanpura
cues: 0-5 s  Hook: chenda melam wall + thavil hits, kombu horn blast, nadaswaram blasts the motif
5-20 s  Low: tanpura drone, veena plays the motif low, morsing, ghatam and kanjira ticking, sarangi swells
20-30 s  Build: mridangam and tabla rolls, sitar and sarod jhala, parai and urumi, khartal, motif climbs
30-55 s  Peak: chenda, thavil, dhol, pakhawaj; nadaswaram and shehnai trade the theme; sarod and veena answer; santoor, kombu, manjira
55-60 s  Ending: tihai on all drums, nadaswaram holds the last note
brief.sound: Indian classical and folk instruments only (about 22 different ones); no Western orchestra, guitar, piano, synth or drum kit
brief.revision: v3, 28 Oct 2026, owner's notes: v1 too slow, gaps too long; use many Indian classical instruments, few Western ones

story: A hero walks back into his city after many years away. The city half-remembers him; then the whole street knows he is back.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
